detail.title: Continuity, Convergence, and Path Dependence in Experience-Driven Preference Formation
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the continuity and convergence properties of experience-driven preference formation under adversarial and governed continuity checks. Building upon existing structural mediation and general preference oracle findings, we maintain our commitments and verify the structural integrity of WAKE's institutional research record.

children.title: Analyze long-term convergence limits under expanded empirical constraints.
